# HexPiece 3.0.6

Your note on Ama no Murakumo's slash. Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass, and I rendered the new wave.

- **The wave of light from C's last cut flies level now.** It was drawn standing upright across its own path, so it looked like a
  vertical arch flying away. Now it's a level crescent of light bowed out ahead in the direction it flies, its ends trailing,
  brighter and a little deeper so you can see it from behind.
